The notification must be added to order #000000304 (Alexander Thomas's most recent pending order)
The correct mechanism is the 'Order Comments' / 'History' section at the bottom of the order page, not the 'Send Email' button which sends a generic email

To add a custom notification message to an order in Magento, the agent should scroll to the bottom of the order page to find the 'Order Comments' or 'History' section which contains a textarea for entering a comment and a checkbox to notify the customer by email
